name: IoNEX Auto Loader
summary: The IoNEX electrolyte analyzer with an integrated auto sampler for walk-away operation. Same Japanese-made ion-selective electrodes, up to 500 tests per hour and CV of 0.5% or less, with 8 electrode combinations of Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻, Ca²⁺ and pH.

specs.label: Parameters
specs.value: Selectable from Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻, Ca²⁺ and pH

specs.label: Electrode combinations
specs.value: Na⁺/K⁺, Na⁺/K⁺/Cl⁻, Na⁺/K⁺/Ca²⁺, Na⁺/K⁺/pH, Na⁺/K⁺/Cl⁻/Ca²⁺, Na⁺/K⁺/Cl⁻/pH and more (8 in total)

specs.label: Analysis time
specs.value: About 35 seconds per sample (without temperature control unit)

specs.label: Sample types
specs.value: Whole blood, serum, plasma, diluted urine; hemodialysis solutions A, B and A+B

specs.label: Connectivity
specs.value: Online communication with laboratory system (sample ID and results)

features: Integrated auto sampler for walk-away operation
High accuracy with CV of 0.5% or less
8 selectable electrode combinations including Ca²⁺ and pH
Dedicated mode for measuring dialysis fluid
Optional barcode reader and LIS connection
